verdict.rationale: Sift publishes its API reference by dated version (v205/v204/v203 with versioned URLs) and keeps a dated changelog that explicitly marks fields as 'Deprecated', and docs guide migration off the legacy Sift Score. However, no formal deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, support windows for older versions) is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit written deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a version-support lifecycle statement, and independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled in practice.
